modes.C_BATTERY: Battery depleting early, reaching ERI/end of life early, or an unexpected battery or longevity reading.
modes.C_INFECTION_POCKET: Infection, pocket erosion, hematoma or sepsis related to the implant site.
modes.C_LEAD_CAPTURE: Pacing not reaching the heart: high or low impedance, loss of capture, high threshold, lead dislodgement or fracture, header or connection problem, no pacing.
modes.C_OTHER: No identifiable failure mode, insufficient information, or a reason outside this list.
modes.C_PREVENTIVE: Device explanted or replaced as a precaution because of an advisory, field safety notice or recall, with no malfunction observed in this device.
modes.C_SENSING: The device sensed the wrong signals: over-sensing, under-sensing, noise or artifact, leading to wrong pacing or inappropriate therapy.
modes.C_TELEMETRY_SOFTWARE: Communication, interrogation, telemetry, programming, software or firmware problem, unexpected reset or back-up mode, wrong data or display.
modes.D_ADHESIVE_DISLODGED: The pod or infusion set came off the body or was dislodged: adhesive failed, peeled, fell or was knocked off.
modes.D_ALARM_ELECTRONICS: Pump or pod electronics: fault or error alarm, battery, button, display, power, software or app, controller or communication, overheating, motor or drive problem, missing history.
modes.D_CANNULA_INSERTION: The needle or cannula did not deploy, deployed early, bent, kinked or was not inserted properly.
modes.D_LEAK: Insulin leaked from the pump, pod, reservoir or infusion site.
modes.D_OCCLUSION_DELIVERY: Insulin flow blocked or delivered wrongly: occlusion alarm, blockage, under- or over-delivery, delivery stopped.
modes.D_OTHER: No identifiable failure mode (e.g. high blood glucose with no device problem named), insufficient information, or a reason outside this list.
modes.D_SKIN: Skin reaction at the infusion site: irritation, rash, itching, redness, allergy or site infection.
modes.O_BONE_FRACTURE: The patient's bone around the implant fractured (periprosthetic fracture), e.g. femur, tibia, patella or acetabulum.
modes.O_DEVICE_FRACTURE: An implant component (stem, liner, insert, post, shell, tray, head) broke, cracked, fractured or dissociated from its mating part, in or out of the patient.
modes.O_INFECTION: Infection around the hip or knee implant (periprosthetic joint infection): revision, spacer, irrigation and debridement, or antibiotics because of infection.
modes.O_INSTABILITY: The joint dislocated, subluxed or was unstable or lax; includes malposition or malalignment causing instability.
modes.O_INTRAOP: A problem during surgery or handling before implantation: component would not seat or lock, difficult insertion, wrong size, packaging or sterility problem, trial or instrument issue.
modes.O_LOOSENING: The implant came loose from bone or failed to grow into or fix to bone (aseptic loosening, lack of osseointegration, subsidence, migration).
modes.O_OTHER: No identifiable failure mode, insufficient information, revision for an unknown reason, or a reason outside this list (e.g. blood clots, literature summaries).
modes.O_PAIN_STIFFNESS: Pain, stiffness, arthrofibrosis or reduced range of motion with no more specific cause named.
modes.O_WEAR: Wear of bearing surfaces or a reaction to wear debris or metal: polyethylene wear, osteolysis, metallosis, adverse local tissue reaction, corrosion, elevated metal ions.
